reviewedInvariants: Exact original account/id/inception/funding and ledger path, with no initialize/reseed or inception-rate replacement.
One private financial owner and same account across restart; metadata reporting v2 leaves legacy financial and reporting history intact.
Trading SOL at current USD is separate from passive initial SOL valuation; absent costs remain unknown.
Qualification raw proof is prepared asynchronously before new risk; required validation and current certificate remain mandatory.
Diagnostic recorder refusal closes new risk and quarantines candidate evidence without throwing through owned financial work.
Backup validation includes optional operating v2 metadata and preserves good recovery generations.
Root-owned immutable release path requires root ownership of each file, without weakening legacy fixture ownership.
Restart run-index compaction preserves the referenced current-market recovery checkpoint.
Public presentation is bounded independently of durable financial history and retains every open position.
limitations: No original private ledger access or modification.
No real-market request, account cutover, deployment, or live PAPER order/position management verified by this review.
Provider sustainability, actual publisher identity/parity and source operation must be measured after legitimate original-account installation.
